The left side is a terrestrial food chain, from bottom to top in order: Plant, Grasshopper, Mouse, Snake, Hawk, with arrows upward. The right side is an aquatic food chain, from bottom to top in order: Phytoplankton, Zooplankton, Herring, Tuna, Killer whale, with arrows upward. Reasoning: The question asks to identify the producer in the aquatic food web. In scientific knowledge, producers are organisms at the lowest level of the food chain that can make their own food.
